content: Vietnam Labor Code overtime: max 50% of normal daily hours (4h on 8h day), 12h/day total cap, 40h/month, 200h/year (300h/year for exempted sectors: export manufacturing, electricity, telecom, with approval). Pay multipliers: weekday OT 150%, weekly day off OT 200%, public holiday/paid leave OT 300%. Night shift (22:00-06:00) +30% allowance, stacks with OT multipliers. Employers must get employee consent for OT and keep detailed OT records.
